title: GIVING GOD THE FIRST AND BEST

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The Lord said to Moses, "Speak to the Israelites and say to them: 'When you enter the land to which I am taking you and you eat the food of the land, present a portion as an offering to the Lord. Present a loaf from the first of your ground meal and present it as an offering from the threshing floor. Throughout the generations to come you are to give this offering to the Lord from the first of your ground meal.'" — Num 15:17-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Once again God says, "When you enter the land" — repeating His confident promise. And when they arrive and enjoy its bread, they are to give the first portion back to Him. Before they feast, they remember the Giver.

There is deep wisdom in giving God the first of what we have, rather than the leftovers. Offering the "first of your ground meal" was an act of trust and gratitude. It said, "Lord, everything I have comes from You, and I honour You before I meet my own needs." The order matters. What comes first in our giving reveals what comes first in our hearts.

It is easy to give God our leftovers — the scraps of time, energy, and money after everything else has had its share. But this command invites something better: to honour God at the front, not the back, of our lives. When we give Him the first portion, we declare that He is our priority and our provider.

This is not about earning God's favour or triggering wealth in return — Scripture never promises that giving is a transaction that makes us rich. It is about the posture of a grateful heart. And it flows naturally from the gospel. God did not give us His leftovers; He gave His very best, His only Son, first and freely. In response, we gladly give Him the first and best of ourselves — not to gain something from Him, but because He has already given us everything in Christ.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you give God the first of your time and resources, or the leftovers?
2. What does the order of your giving reveal about your heart's priorities?
3. How does God giving His best in Christ shape your response to Him?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You gave Your very best in Christ, holding nothing back. Teach me to honour You with the first and best of my life, not the leftovers. Let my giving flow from a grateful heart that trusts You as my provider. Amen.
